info.title: Redis Agent Memory API
info.description:
API for storing, retrieving, and searching Redis Agent Memory session memory and long-term memory.

Authentication depends on your deployment. Use the credential issued for your Redis Agent Memory service or store. For self-managed deployments, see the self-managed Redis Agent Memory guide for authentication options.

post.description: Creates long-term memories in bulk. Records without namespace or namespaceRef stay un-namespaced. Automatic routing does not place them in a shared namespace. An explicit namespaceRef must pass destination admission and is never rerouted. Admission failures are reported per record in errors.

post.description: Moves long-term memories to an explicit namespaceRef, or automatically routes a memory that is already in a shared namespace when namespaceRef is omitted. Personal and un-namespaced memories are not automatic-routing candidates and keep their current placement with a per-item error. If routing is disabled or no shared destination qualifies, the memory also keeps its current placement and receives a per-item error. An explicit destination must pass admission and is never rerouted. Returns 409 when the explicit destination is archived; automatic routing and admission failures are reported per item in errors.

parameters.name: memoryType
parameters.description:
Identifier of a long-term memory type.

Built-in types include `semantic`, `episodic`, `message`, and `session_summary_view`.
Stores may also register custom memory types; this open string accepts any
registered type name.

Constraints: 1-64 chars, must start with a letter, followed by letters, digits,
underscores, or dashes.

schema.description:
Identifier of a long-term memory type.

Built-in types include `semantic`, `episodic`, `message`, and `session_summary_view`.
Stores may also register custom memory types; this open string accepts any
registered type name.

Constraints: 1-64 chars, must start with a letter, followed by letters, digits,
underscores, or dashes.

idempotencyKey.description: Required when the store selects session.append input hooks. Reuse this key only for an identical request; accepted retries reuse the saved decision and event identity.

sessionId.description: Optional session ID. If omitted, the server generates a unique ID.

actorId.description: Unique actor identifier (1-255 chars). Can represent a user, agent, or any participant.

namespace.description:
Optional deprecated namespace label for the session. This label does not create or resolve a namespace resource. Do not supply it with namespaceRef.

Like `ownerId`, this is a session-level value taken from the first event: the value sent with the first event of a session is stored on the session, and values sent with later events are ignored. Omit it to leave extracted memories without a namespace.

NamespaceFilter.description:
Filter by namespace. Matching is case-insensitive.

Namespace is optional, so records without one need care. The positive operators (`eq`, `in`, `all`) require the field to be present and therefore never match a record that has no namespace — including memories extracted from a session that has none. `ne` is a plain negation and *does* match those records, so use `eq` or `in` when you need strict namespace isolation rather than `ne` against the namespaces you want to exclude.

Omit this filter to search across every namespace, and use it to keep recall inside one project, workspace, team, environment, or tenant.
